name: hall_walk
about: Hall links (issue #358) for building the room view: two far beacons, h at the back of the hall and j on the far side. Quiet for 20 s, somebody walks along h's path, then along j's, j goes silent for a while (stale), then one more walk on h heard only by the board. A person stands in the square the whole time, so both pictures show together. The positions are made up.
